Sympy symbolic equality and standalone exhaustive independent checks over 82,499 Dyck paths support but do not replace infinite proof.

value.rationale: The third near-maximal layer of the natural scattered-subsequence universality statistic on the Dyck context-free language has a complete infinite exact census. The sharp height obstruction bridges two structural invariants and permits rational transfer despite unbounded Dyck height; the result distinguishes height-three paths with different universality indices, beyond a routine existing bounded-height count.
